shapeSummary: Single wheel with its axis along X: a 50 mm OD by 30 mm wide smooth tire ring (inner radius 17 mm) fused to a solid 26 mm wide hub cylinder. The wheel center is at Y=25, so the bottom sits at Y=0, and it is centered in X and Z.
warnings: Diameter and width come from unverified product text.
Tread lugs are omitted as decorative detail.
The 3 mm hex shaft bore is not clearly visible in the image, so it is omitted.
Rim radius (17 mm) and hub width (26 mm) are estimated from the image.
Hub recesses and the central boss are not modeled.
Only one of the two wheels shown is modeled.

r_out = 25.0
w = 30.0
r_rim = 17.0
hub_w = 26.0
